name: PixelSnow-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Densest scatter of white flakes, including a bright large square near the middle.

tagline: Pixel-sized snow drifts down across a black stage.
summary: Tiny square snow flecks fall steadily through black space, larger and brighter close up and fading to specks in the distance. It adds a quiet winter drift to a dark section.
appearance: A black stage is dusted with tiny white square flecks spread evenly at many sizes. Nearer flakes are bigger and brighter while distant ones shrink to single pixels, giving a sense of depth.
behaviour: The flakes drift steadily downward with a slight sideways lean, tumbling at different speeds. The fall runs quietly from the moment it loads and never repeats.
demo_content: White square flakes falling on black at default density and speed.
search_phrases: snowfall effect for a dark hero
gentle snow backdrop for a website
use_when: A dark seasonal or festive page wants a light snowfall without using images.
avoid_when: Delicate white specks nearly vanish on light backgrounds and behind busy content.
customise: Colour, flake size, pixel resolution, speed, density, depth fade, brightness, flake shape and fall direction are props.
weight_why: A ray march of up to 128 steps per pixel for the snow field every frame.

a11y.note: A canvas backdrop with no labels; the endless fall ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Quiet, even snowfall with believable depth; flecks are tiny and barely read at gallery size.
title: Pixel Snow
